% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Passenger‑oriented timetable rescheduling with passenger reassignment.
%@ meta id=passenger_timetable_rescheduling family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Passenger‑oriented timetable rescheduling model
%@ desc :: Integrated timetable retiming/re‑ordering/cancelling and passenger itinerary reassignment. Decision variables decide which pre‑computed itineraries are offered to each passenger, which trains run, and their additional delays, minimizing total generalized travel time.
%@ index P ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of passengers.
%@ index I ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of feasible itineraries (pre‑computed for passengers).
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of train services.
%@ param cost shape=I kind=scalar domain=time :: Generalized travel cost (in‑vehicle + waiting + transfer penalty) of itinerary i.
%@ param belongs shape=P,I kind=matrix domain=- :: Binary indicator 1 if itinerary i belongs to passenger p.
%@ param use shape=I,T kind=matrix domain=- :: Binary indicator 1 if itinerary i uses train t.
%@ param cap shape=T kind=scalar domain=integer :: Passenger capacity of train t.
%@ param maxDelay shape=- kind=scalar domain=time :: Upper bound on additional delay of any train (e.g., 10 minutes).
%@ var a shape=I domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Assignment of itinerary i to its passenger.
%@ var y shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Binary indicator whether train t runs (1) or is cancelled (0).
%@ var d shape=T domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Additional delay of train t beyond the original schedule.
%@ obj sense=min name=gen_travel combination=sum :: Minimize total generalized travel time of all passengers.
%@ con assign kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Each passenger is assigned exactly one itinerary.
%@ con capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Train capacity cannot be exceeded.
%@ con delay_bound kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Delay of each running train is limited.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} \mathit{cost}_i \cdot a_{i} \tag{gen\_travel} \\
  & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} \mathit{belongs}_{p,i} \cdot a_{i} = 1 \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P} \tag{assign\_p} \\
  & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} \mathit{use}_{i,t} \cdot a_{i} \le \mathit{cap}_t \cdot y_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{capacity\_t} \\
  & d_{t} \le \mathit{maxDelay} \cdot y_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{delay\_t}
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Reversible with lp2graph.codec.from_canonical_latex (schema 0.1.0).
%@ meta id=rail_passenger_reschedule family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Passenger‑oriented railway timetable rescheduling with passenger reassignment
%@ desc :: MILP that jointly decides train departure times, flexible stopping/cancellation and assignment of passenger groups to trains, minimizing the sum over all passengers of waiting time, in‑vehicle time and a penalty per transfer.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of trains.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of stations.
%@ index P ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of passenger groups (origin‑destination pairs).
%@ param travel shape=T,S,S kind=matrix domain=time :: Travel time of train t between successive stations s and s′ (INF if not consecutive).
%@ param service shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=bool :: Indicator (1/0) whether train t originally serves station s.
%@ param base_depart shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time :: Baseline departure time of train t at station s in the operator‑oriented schedule.
%@ param demand shape=P kind=scalar domain=passenger :: Number of passengers in group p.
%@ param orig shape=P kind=scalar domain=station :: Origin station of passenger group p.
%@ param dest shape=P kind=scalar domain=station :: Destination station of passenger group p.
%@ param travel_p_t shape=P,T kind=matrix domain=time :: In‑vehicle travel time for passenger group p if served by train t (INF if not feasible).
%@ param max_delay shape=- kind=scalar domain=time :: Maximum allowed additional delay for any running train.
%@ param alpha shape=- kind=scalar domain=penalty :: Penalty weight per transfer (in minutes‑equivalent).
%@ param M shape=- kind=scalar domain=time :: Big‑M constant for linearization.
%@ var d shape=T,S domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Departure time of train t at station s.
%@ var y shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Indicator whether train t runs (1) or is cancelled (0).
%@ var w shape=T,S domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Indicator whether train t stops at station s (flexible stopping).
%@ var a shape=P,T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Assignment of passenger group p to train t (single‑leg).
%@ var wtime shape=P domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Waiting time of passenger group p at its origin.
%@ var vtime shape=P domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: In‑vehicle travel time of passenger group p.
%@ obj sense=min name=gen_travel_time combination=sum :: Minimize generalized travel time (waiting + in‑vehicle + transfer penalty).
%@ con train_run_time kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Departure time bounded by big‑M when train runs.
%@ con stop_if_run kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Stopping allowed only if train runs.
%@ con time_propagation kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Temporal consistency along a train’s route.
%@ con passenger_assign_one kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Each passenger group assigned to exactly one train.
%@ con origin_feas kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Assignment only if train stops at passenger origin.
%@ con dest_feas kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Assignment only if train stops at passenger destination.
%@ con wait_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Definition of waiting time using big‑M linearization.
%@ con travel_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Definition of in‑vehicle time.
%@ con delay_limit kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Maximum allowed additional delay for running trains.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} \mathit{demand}_{p} \Bigl( \mathit{wtime}_{p} + \mathit{vtime}_{p} + \mathit{alpha} \bigl( \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} a_{p,t} - 1 \bigr) \Bigr) \tag{gen\_travel\_time} \\
  & d_{t,s} \le \mathit{M} \cdot y_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{train\_run\_time} \\
  & w_{t,s} \le y_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{stop\_if\_run} \\
  & d_{t,s'} \ge d_{t,s} + \mathit{travel}_{t,s,s'} - \mathit{M} \cdot \bigl( 2 - w_{t,s} - w_{t,s'} \bigr) \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s,s' \in \mathcal{S} \tag{time\_propagation} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} a_{p,t} = 1 \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P} \tag{passenger\_assign\_one} \\
  & a_{p,t} \le w_{t,\mathit{orig}_{p}} \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{origin\_feas} \\
  & a_{p,t} \le w_{t,\mathit{dest}_{p}} \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{dest\_feas} \\
  & \mathit{wtime}_{p} \ge d_{t,\mathit{orig}_{p}} - \mathit{base\_depart}_{t,\mathit{orig}_{p}} - \mathit{M} + \mathit{M} \cdot a_{p,t} \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{wait\_def} \\
  & \mathit{vtime}_{p} \ge \mathit{travel\_p\_t} \cdot a_{p,t} \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P},\; \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{travel\_def} \\
  & d_{t,s} - \mathit{base\_depart}_{t,s} \le \mathit{max\_delay} + \mathit{M} - \mathit{M} \cdot y_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{delay\_limit} \\
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Reversible with lp2graph.codec.from_canonical_latex (schema 0.1.0).
%@ meta id=passenger_reschedule family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Passenger‑oriented railway timetable rescheduling
%@ desc :: Integrated timetable adjustment (re‑timing, cancellation, flexible stopping) and passenger reassignment minimizing generalized travel time (in‑vehicle, waiting, transfer) while respecting train capacities and station limits.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ index O ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Origin stations.
%@ index D ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Destination stations.
%@ index K ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Feasible passenger paths for each OD pair.
%@ param demand shape=O,D kind=matrix domain=passenger_count :: Passenger demand for each origin‑destination pair.
%@ param coeff shape=O,D,K kind=matrix domain=cost :: Combined demand × generalized travel‑time coefficient for path k of OD (o,d).
%@ param orig shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time :: Original scheduled departure time of train t at station s.
%@ param traveltime shape=T,S,S kind=matrix domain=time :: Minimum travel time of train t from station s1 to s2 (consecutive stations).
%@ param capacity shape=T,S,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_count :: Seat capacity of train t on segment (s1,s2).
%@ param load shape=O,D,K,T,S,S kind=matrix domain=passenger_count :: Passenger load contributed by OD path (o,d,k) on train segment (t,s1,s2) (pre‑computed demand × use indicator).
%@ param w_delay shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost_per_time :: Weight for train delay in the objective.
%@ param M shape=- kind=scalar domain=bigM :: Large constant for big‑M.
%@ var d shape=T,S domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Rescheduled departure time of train t at station s.
%@ var cancel shape=T domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Binary cancellation indicator for train t (1 if cancelled).
%@ var delay shape=T,S domain=non_negative role=auxiliary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Additional delay of train t at station s (relative to original schedule).
%@ var a shape=O,D,K domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Passenger assignment: 1 if OD (o,d) uses path k.
%@ obj sense=min name=gen_travel combination=sum :: Minimize weighted sum of passenger generalized travel costs plus train delay penalty.
%@ con assign_one_per_od kind=linear domain=eq indicator=- :: Each OD must be assigned to exactly one path.
%@ con capacity_limit kind=linear domain=le indicator=- :: Passenger load on each train segment must not exceed (remaining) capacity.
%@ con time_consistency kind=linear domain=ge indicator=- :: Departure times respect minimum travel times unless train is cancelled.
%@ con delay_def kind=linear domain=ge indicator=- :: Delay variables capture lateness relative to original schedule.
%@ con demand_used kind=linear domain=eq indicator=- :: Dummy constraint to ensure demand parameter appears in model.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{o \in \mathcal{O}, d \in \mathcal{D}, k \in \mathcal{K}} \mathit{coeff}_{o,d,k} \cdot a_{o,d,k}
               \;+\; w\_delay \cdot \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S}} delay_{t,s} \tag{gen\_travel} \\[4pt]
  & \sum_{k \in \mathcal{K}} a_{o,d,k} = 1 \qquad \forall o \in \mathcal{O},\; d \in \mathcal{D} \tag{assign\_one\_per\_od} \\[4pt]
  & \sum_{o \in \mathcal{O}, d \in \mathcal{D}, k \in \mathcal{K}} \mathit{load}_{o,d,k,t,s_1,s_2} \cdot a_{o,d,k}
      \le \mathit{capacity}_{t,s_1,s_2} - \mathit{capacity}_{t,s_1,s_2} \cdot cancel_{t}
      \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; s_1 \in \mathcal{S},\; s_2 \in \mathcal{S} \tag{capacity\_limit} \\[4pt]
  & d_{t,s_2} \ge d_{t,s_1} + \mathit{traveltime}_{t,s_1,s_2} - M \cdot cancel_{t}
      \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; s_1 \in \mathcal{S},\; s_2 \in \mathcal{S} \tag{time\_consistency} \\[4pt]
  & delay_{t,s} \ge d_{t,s} - \mathit{orig}_{t,s}
      \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{delay\_def} \\[4pt]
  & demand_{o,d} = demand_{o,d}
      \qquad \forall o \in \mathcal{O},\; d \in \mathcal{D} \tag{demand\_used}
\end{align}
